title: Boil or Burn? Properties Explained Simply | PUC Chemistry Class 11
description:
Ice melts, a matchstick burns to black and milk turns sour. In one of them the stuff stays the same, in the other two something new is made. In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Chemistry (NCERT Chapter 1, Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry) Diya watches water boil over a gas flame and asks what really changes.

You will see the two kinds of property: physical properties (colour, odour, melting point, boiling point, density) that we observe without changing the substance, and chemical properties (acidity or basicity, combustibility) that show up only when a new substance forms. On the molecule bench, boiling water molecules escape as vapour with every O-H bond intact, then methane meets oxygen, the old bonds break and electrons pair up into carbon dioxide and water, with a live atom counter. Then density built step by step, a worked example (27 g block, 10 cm3, 2.7 g/cm3), everyday changes sorted, the exam trap about heat, an original NEET pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

This is Episode 4 of our PUC Chemistry series.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11, NEET and JEE Main students.
